Alora Mood Willow WV648217MB 17-Inch Vanity Light in Matte Black

The Alora Mood Willow WV648217MB is a 17-inch, two-light vanity fixture with a sculptural all-steel design and a Matte Black finish. Its compact form, directional shades, and flexible horizontal or vertical installation make it a practical choice for bathrooms, powder rooms, hallways, entryways, and other damp-rated interior spaces.

Key Strengths

  • Two-Light Vanity Design: Uses two replaceable E12 bulbs to provide balanced illumination across a mirror or wall surface.
  • All-Steel Construction: Features steel fixture components and steel shades for a cohesive, modern appearance.
  • Matte Black Finish: Adds a clean, versatile accent that works well with contemporary, industrial, transitional, and minimalist interiors.
  • Horizontal or Vertical Installation: Can be mounted above a mirror or vertically beside one.
  • Up/Down Illumination: The opposing shade arrangement directs light outward in two directions.
  • Damp-Location Rated: Suitable for bathrooms, powder rooms, and other indoor areas exposed to normal humidity.
  • Replaceable E12 Lamps: Allows compatible bulb selection based on preferred brightness, color temperature, efficiency, and dimming performance.
  • UL Certified: The manufacturer documentation identifies the fixture as UL certified.

Product Overview

The Willow WV648217MB offers a distinctive interpretation of vanity lighting through its rounded steel shades and compact central canopy. The symmetrical two-light layout creates a balanced visual profile that works equally well as a vanity fixture or decorative wall light.

The fixture measures 16-3/4 inches wide, 5 inches high, and extends 6-5/8 inches from the wall. Its compact dimensions make it well suited to smaller vanity mirrors, powder rooms, narrow wall sections, and paired installations beside a mirror.

The fixture uses two E12 Type G bulbs, each with a maximum rating of 60 watts. Bulbs are not included. Because the light sources are replaceable, users can select compatible lamps according to the desired brightness, color temperature, energy efficiency, and dimming capability.

The steel shades create focused directional illumination rather than a fully diffused glow. Actual lumen output, color rendering, color temperature, and dimming performance depend on the selected bulbs.

Ideal Applications

  • Bathroom vanity lighting
  • Powder rooms
  • Small vanity mirrors
  • Paired vertical mirror lighting
  • Hallways
  • Entryways
  • Bedroom accent lighting
  • Dressing areas
  • Other damp-rated indoor wall-lighting applications

Performance

Directional Two-Light Output

The opposing steel shades direct light outward in two directions, helping provide focused illumination across a vanity or wall surface. The final beam spread and brightness depend on the selected bulb type.

Compact Profile

At 16-3/4 inches wide, the fixture is sized for smaller mirrors and narrow wall areas while still providing the visual balance of a two-light configuration.

Flexible Installation Orientation

The fixture is approved for horizontal or vertical wall mounting. Horizontal placement works well above a mirror, while vertical placement allows installation beside a mirror or on a narrow architectural surface.

Replaceable Light Sources

The standard E12 sockets allow the bulbs to be replaced individually. This gives users flexibility to choose compatible lamps with the preferred lumen output, color temperature, appearance, and dimming characteristics.

Damp-Rated Construction

The manufacturer rates the fixture for damp locations, making it suitable for normal bathroom and powder-room humidity when installed in an approved area and in accordance with applicable electrical codes.

Installation Guide

The Willow WV648217MB is intended for installation on a wall-mounted electrical junction box. Before beginning installation, disconnect power at the circuit breaker or fuse panel and verify that the circuit is de-energized.

Confirm that the electrical box is securely mounted and suitable for supporting the fixture. Attach the mounting bracket in accordance with the official manufacturer instructions. Select the desired horizontal or vertical orientation before securing the fixture body.

Connect the fixture hot conductor to the supply hot conductor, the fixture neutral conductor to the supply neutral conductor, and the fixture grounding conductor to the grounding system using approved wire connectors. Carefully place all completed connections inside the junction box without pinching or damaging the wires.

Secure the fixture to the mounting bracket and verify that the canopy sits evenly against the wall. Install two compatible E12 Type G bulbs rated at no more than 60 watts each. Restore power only after all components are secure and installation is complete.

Installation should be completed by a qualified electrician and must comply with applicable local and national electrical codes. Always follow the official manufacturer instructions supplied with the fixture.

Mounting Options

The verified mounting options are horizontal or vertical wall installation. Horizontal installation is typically used above a vanity mirror, while vertical installation can be used beside a mirror or as a decorative wall-lighting feature.

The fixture extends 6-5/8 inches from the wall. Before installation, confirm adequate clearance from mirrors, medicine cabinets, doors, shelving, cabinetry, and adjacent architectural elements.

The fixture is rated for damp locations but is not identified as wet-location rated. Install it only in bathroom zones where damp-rated fixtures are permitted by applicable electrical codes.

Wiring & Safety

  • Use the fixture only on a 120V electrical system.
  • Disconnect electrical power before installation, cleaning, servicing, or bulb replacement.
  • Use two E12 bulbs and do not exceed 60 watts per bulb.
  • Use matching bulbs for consistent appearance and light output.
  • Secure all wire connections with approved connectors.
  • Verify proper grounding before restoring power.
  • Do not install the fixture in a wet or outdoor location.
  • Confirm that the selected bathroom location permits a damp-rated fixture.
  • Allow the bulbs and steel shades to cool before touching or servicing.
  • Follow all applicable electrical codes and official manufacturer instructions.

Certifications

The official manufacturer specification sheet identifies the Willow WV648217MB as UL certified and rated for damp indoor locations.

Compatible Accessories & Dimmers

Dimming capability depends on the selected E12 bulbs. When dimming is required, use dimmable lamps and a wall dimmer that the bulb manufacturer confirms is compatible with those lamps and the connected load. Each bulb must remain within the fixture's maximum rating of 60 watts.

column2: Alora Mood Willow 31-in Vanity Light VL548431
column3:
Alora Mood Willow VL548431MBOP 31-Inch Vanity Light in Matte Black and Opal Matte Glass

The Alora Mood Willow VL548431MBOP is a 31-inch, four-light vanity fixture that combines a Matte Black steel frame with four Opal Matte Glass shades. Its balanced horizontal profile, soft diffused light, and flexible horizontal or vertical mounting make it suitable for bathrooms, powder rooms, dressing areas, hallways, entryways, and other damp-rated interior spaces.

Key Strengths

  • Four-Light Vanity Design: Uses four replaceable E12 bulbs to provide broad, balanced illumination across a mirror or wall surface.
  • Opal Matte Glass Shades: Softens the appearance of the selected bulbs and helps reduce direct glare.
  • Matte Black Finish: Creates a clean, contemporary contrast with the soft white glass shades.
  • Horizontal or Vertical Mounting: Can be installed above a mirror or vertically beside one.
  • Damp-Location Rated: Suitable for bathrooms, powder rooms, and other indoor areas exposed to normal humidity.
  • Standard E12 Sockets: Allows compatible bulb selection based on preferred brightness, color temperature, efficiency, and dimming performance.
  • UL Certified: The manufacturer identifies the fixture as UL certified.
  • Installation Hardware Included: Manufacturer-supplied installation hardware is included.

Product Overview

The Willow collection blends decorative glass forms with a streamlined metal structure. The VL548431MBOP features four rounded Opal Matte Glass shades arranged across an elongated Matte Black backplate, creating a balanced fixture with a strong visual presence.

The fixture measures 31 inches wide, 5-1/4 inches high, and extends 6-1/2 inches from the wall. Its four-light format makes it well suited to medium and large vanity mirrors while maintaining a relatively low-profile wall projection.

The fixture uses four E12 Type G bulbs, each with a maximum rating of 60 watts. Bulbs are not included. Because the light sources are replaceable, users can select compatible lamps according to preferred brightness, color temperature, energy efficiency, appearance, and dimming capability.

The Opal Matte Glass shades conceal the direct view of the bulbs and produce a softer lighting effect. Actual lumen output, color rendering, color temperature, and dimming performance depend on the lamps selected.

Ideal Applications

  • Bathroom vanity lighting
  • Powder rooms
  • Guest bathrooms
  • Medium and large vanity mirrors
  • Dressing rooms and makeup areas
  • Paired vertical mirror installations
  • Hallways and entryways
  • Bedroom accent lighting
  • Other damp-rated indoor wall-lighting applications

Performance

Broad Four-Light Illumination

The four-light arrangement distributes illumination across a wider area than smaller vanity fixtures. When installed horizontally, it can provide practical ambient and task lighting above medium and large mirrors.

Soft Diffusion

The Opal Matte Glass shades soften the appearance of the bulbs and help reduce direct glare, creating a more comfortable lighting effect for bathrooms and dressing areas.

Flexible Installation Orientation

The fixture is approved for horizontal or vertical wall mounting. Horizontal installation is ideal above a mirror, while vertical installation can be used beside a mirror or as a decorative wall feature.

Replaceable Light Sources

The standard E12 sockets allow the bulbs to be replaced individually. This provides flexibility to choose compatible lamps with the preferred lumen output, color temperature, efficiency, and dimming characteristics.

Damp-Rated Construction

The manufacturer rates the fixture for damp locations, making it suitable for normal bathroom and powder-room humidity when installed in an approved area and in accordance with applicable electrical codes.

Installation Guide

The Willow VL548431MBOP is designed for installation on a wall-mounted electrical junction box. Before beginning installation, disconnect power at the circuit breaker or fuse panel and verify that the circuit is de-energized.

Confirm that the electrical box is securely mounted and suitable for supporting the fixture. Attach the manufacturer-supplied mounting bracket according to the official installation instructions. Select the desired horizontal or vertical orientation before securing the fixture body.

Connect the fixture hot conductor to the supply hot conductor, the fixture neutral conductor to the supply neutral conductor, and the fixture grounding conductor to the grounding system using approved wire connectors. Carefully place all completed connections inside the junction box without pinching or damaging the wires.

Secure the fixture to the mounting bracket and verify that the canopy sits evenly against the wall. Install the glass shades and retaining components carefully. Do not over-tighten hardware against the glass.

Install four compatible E12 Type G bulbs rated at no more than 60 watts each. Bulbs are sold separately. Restore power only after installation is complete and all fixture components are secure.

Installation should be performed by a qualified electrician and must comply with applicable local and national electrical codes. Always follow the official manufacturer instructions supplied with the fixture.

Mounting Options

The verified mounting options are horizontal or vertical wall installation. Horizontal installation is typically used above a vanity mirror, while vertical installation can be used beside a mirror or as a decorative wall-lighting feature.

The fixture extends 6-1/2 inches from the wall. Before installation, confirm adequate clearance from mirrors, medicine cabinets, doors, shelving, cabinetry, and adjacent architectural elements.

The fixture is rated for damp locations but is not identified as wet-location rated. Install it only in bathroom zones where damp-rated fixtures are permitted by applicable electrical codes.

Wiring & Safety

  • Use the fixture only on a 120V electrical system.
  • Disconnect electrical power before installation, cleaning, servicing, or bulb replacement.
  • Use four E12 bulbs and do not exceed 60 watts per bulb.
  • Use matching bulbs for consistent appearance and light output.
  • Secure all wire connections with approved connectors.
  • Verify proper grounding before restoring power.
  • Do not install the fixture in a wet or outdoor location.
  • Confirm that the selected bathroom location permits a damp-rated fixture.
  • Do not over-tighten mounting or retaining hardware against the glass shades.
  • Allow bulbs and glass components to cool before touching or servicing.
  • Follow all applicable electrical codes and official manufacturer instructions.

Certifications

The official manufacturer product information identifies the Willow VL548431MBOP as UL certified and rated for damp indoor locations.

Compatible Accessories & Dimmers

Dimming capability depends on the selected E12 bulbs. When dimming is required, use dimmable lamps and a wall dimmer that the bulb manufacturer confirms is compatible with those lamps and the connected load. Each bulb must remain within the fixture's maximum rating of 60 watts.

Alora Mood Speakeasy 18-in Pendant Matte Black PD544517MBWL

The Alora Mood Speakeasy PD544517MBWL is an 18-inch, one-light pendant that combines a Matte Black steel structure with a White Linen shade. Its balanced proportions, fabric diffuser, and adjustable suspension make it a refined choice for residential interiors that need soft ambient lighting and a distinctive decorative focal point.

Key Strengths

  • Soft White Linen Shade: The linen shade diffuses the light source and creates a comfortable, softened glow.
  • Matte Black Finish: The dark finish gives the pendant a clean, modern character that works well in contemporary and transitional rooms.
  • Standard E26 Lamp Base: The fixture accepts one standard E26 A19 bulb, giving the user flexibility to select the preferred brightness and color temperature.
  • Sloped-Ceiling Adaptable: The pendant is designed to remain suitable for installation on angled or vaulted ceilings.
  • Field-Adjustable Suspension: An 84-inch wire and adjustable hanging arrangement help accommodate different ceiling heights.
  • Dry-Location Rated: The fixture is intended for indoor dry locations such as dining rooms, bedrooms, living spaces, and entry areas.
  • UL Certified: The official specification sheet identifies the fixture as UL certified for the United States and Canada.

Product Overview

The Speakeasy pendant is designed around a classic drum-inspired linen shade suspended from a coordinated steel support system. The combination of Matte Black hardware and White Linen creates a strong visual contrast while keeping the overall appearance clean and versatile. The fixture can serve as a central decorative feature without overwhelming surrounding furnishings or architectural details.

The pendant measures 18 inches in diameter and 32-1/2 inches in overall fixture height. The shade itself measures 18 inches in diameter by 10-1/2 inches high. These proportions create a noticeable presence over a dining table, kitchen island, reading area, or entry zone while remaining compact enough for many residential ceiling plans.

The fixture uses one E26 A19 bulb with a maximum wattage of 60 watts. The bulb is not included, allowing the buyer to choose a compatible lamp based on desired lumen output, color temperature, lamp appearance, and dimming requirements. Because the fixture does not include an integrated LED module, future lamp replacement is straightforward.

The Speakeasy pendant is designed for omni-directional illumination. The White Linen shade softens and distributes the lamp output around the fixture, helping create general ambient lighting rather than a narrow directional beam. The final brightness and dimming performance depend on the selected bulb.

Ideal Applications

  • Dining rooms and breakfast areas
  • Kitchen islands and counters
  • Living rooms and sitting areas
  • Bedrooms and bedside zones
  • Reading nooks and home libraries
  • Entryways, foyers, and hallways
  • Vaulted or sloped-ceiling interiors
  • Dry indoor hospitality spaces

Key Performance Benefits

Comfortable Ambient Illumination

The White Linen shade helps soften the appearance of the bulb and reduce direct glare. Light is distributed around the fixture to support comfortable ambient illumination in residential spaces.

Flexible Lamp Selection

The standard E26 socket allows the user to choose from many compatible A19 lamps. This makes it possible to select a bulb based on preferred lumen output, warm or neutral color temperature, energy use, and dimming capability, provided the chosen lamp does not exceed the fixture’s 60-watt maximum rating.

Adjustable Hanging Height

The fixture includes 84 inches of wire and a field-adjustable suspension arrangement. The official minimum hanging height is 36 inches, allowing the installer to adjust the drop while respecting the manufacturer’s dimensional limitations.

Suitable for Sloped Ceilings

The fixture is identified as sloped-ceiling adaptable. This allows it to be considered for vaulted and angled ceiling applications where a pendant must hang level below the mounting point.

Replaceable Light Source

Unlike fixtures with a permanently integrated LED board, the Speakeasy uses a replaceable bulb. When the lamp reaches the end of its service life, the bulb can be replaced without replacing the complete fixture.

Installation & Wiring Guide

The Speakeasy PD544517MBWL is intended for suspended installation from a ceiling-mounted electrical junction box. Before beginning installation, disconnect electrical power at the breaker or fuse panel and verify that the circuit is de-energized.

The ceiling junction box and supporting structure must be properly installed and capable of supporting the fixture. Attach the manufacturer-supplied mounting hardware to the electrical box according to the official installation instructions. Adjust the suspension to the required hanging height while maintaining the manufacturer-specified minimum hanging height of 36 inches.

Route the fixture conductors through the canopy and suspension components as directed. Connect the supply hot conductor, neutral conductor, and grounding conductor to the corresponding fixture wires using approved wire connectors. The official specification sheet identifies the fixture wire color as black.

After completing the electrical connections, carefully place the conductors inside the junction box and secure the canopy against the ceiling. Confirm that the fixture hangs evenly and that all hardware, supports, fasteners, and decorative components are secure before restoring power.

Install one compatible E26 A19 bulb rated at no more than 60 watts. The bulb is sold separately. Do not energize the fixture until the installation is complete and the bulb is properly seated in the socket.

Installation should be performed by a qualified electrician and must comply with applicable local and national electrical codes. Always follow the manufacturer’s official installation instructions supplied with the fixture.

Mounting Options

The verified mounting method is suspended ceiling installation. The fixture uses a decorative chain-and-wire suspension arrangement and includes an 84-inch field-adjustable wire. The official dimensional drawing indicates a maximum adjustable suspension dimension of 72 inches.

The fixture is suitable for sloped-ceiling applications. When installed on an angled or vaulted ceiling, the suspension allows the pendant body to hang vertically below the canopy. The mounting box and ceiling support must remain appropriate for the fixture and installation conditions.

The official minimum hanging height is 36 inches. Before installation, confirm that the selected drop provides adequate clearance above tables, counters, walking paths, doors, and furniture.

Wiring & Safety

  • Use the fixture only on a 120V electrical system.
  • Disconnect electrical power before installation, cleaning, servicing, or bulb replacement.
  • Use one E26 A19 bulb and do not exceed the 60-watt maximum rating.
  • Do not install the fixture in damp, wet, or outdoor locations.
  • Ensure the ceiling electrical box and supporting structure are suitable for the fixture.
  • Secure all wire connections with approved connectors.
  • Confirm proper grounding before restoring power.
  • Do not modify the fixture wiring, socket, canopy, or structural components.
  • Allow the bulb and fixture to cool before touching or replacing the lamp.
  • Follow all applicable electrical codes and the official manufacturer instructions.

Certifications

The official Alora Mood specification sheet identifies the Speakeasy PD544517 as UL certified for safety in the United States and Canada. The fixture is rated for dry indoor locations.

Compatible Accessories & Dimmers

Dimming capability depends on the selected E26 A19 bulb. When dimming is required, use a dimmable bulb and a wall dimmer that the bulb manufacturer confirms is compatible with that lamp type and electrical load. The selected bulb must not exceed the fixture’s maximum rating of 60 watts.

column3:
Alora Mood Sylvia CH515226MBCL 26-Inch Chandelier

The Alora Mood Sylvia CH515226MBCL is a four-light indoor chandelier featuring a Matte Black steel frame and clear glass shades. Its curved, balanced profile and omnidirectional lamp arrangement make it a decorative lighting choice for dining rooms, living rooms, bedrooms, foyers, and other dry interior spaces.

Key Strengths

  • Four-Light Design: Uses four E12-base bulbs to provide decorative ambient illumination.
  • Clear Glass Shades: Keeps the lamps visible and gives the fixture a bright, open appearance.
  • Matte Black Finish: Provides a clean, modern contrast suitable for contemporary interiors.
  • Adjustable Downrod Suspension: Includes multiple rod sections with up to 46 inches of total rod length.
  • Sloped-Ceiling Adaptable: Supports installation on ceilings angled up to 45 degrees.
  • Replaceable Bulbs: Allows the user to select compatible E12 lamps based on brightness, color temperature, and dimming preferences.

Product Overview

The Sylvia CH515226MBCL chandelier from Alora Mood combines a sculptural steel frame with four clear glass shades arranged around the fixture. The Matte Black finish emphasizes the curved arms and creates a refined silhouette that works well in modern, transitional, and eclectic residential interiors.

The fixture measures 26-1/2 inches in diameter and 14-7/8 inches high. It uses four E12-base bulbs, with a maximum wattage of 60 watts per bulb. Bulbs are not included, allowing the customer to select compatible lamps that suit the desired appearance and performance.

Clear glass shades preserve direct visibility of the lamps and allow light to travel in multiple directions. The official specification sheet identifies the illumination direction as omnidirectional and rates the chandelier for dry indoor locations.

Ideal For

  • Dining rooms
  • Living rooms
  • Bedrooms
  • Foyers and entryways
  • Kitchen dining areas
  • Stairwells with suitable ceiling support
  • Dry indoor hospitality spaces

Key Performance Benefits

The four-light arrangement distributes illumination around the fixture rather than directing it toward a single surface. This makes the Sylvia chandelier suitable for ambient lighting while also serving as a decorative focal point.

Because the fixture uses replaceable E12 lamps, users can choose compatible bulbs based on preferred lumen output, color temperature, lamp shape, and dimming performance. Each socket supports a maximum 60-watt bulb.

The included modular downrods provide installation flexibility. The fixture includes three 12-inch rods, one 6-inch rod, and one 4-inch rod, creating a maximum combined rod length of 46 inches. The official minimum hanging height is 34 inches.

The fixture is also adaptable to sloped ceilings up to 45 degrees, allowing installation in rooms with angled ceiling conditions when properly supported and installed according to applicable electrical codes.

The fixture must be mounted to a properly installed and structurally supported electrical junction box. Route the fixture conductors through the selected downrods and canopy before completing the electrical connections.

Installation should be performed by a qualified, licensed electrician. Disconnect electrical power at the breaker or fuse panel before assembly, wiring, servicing, or bulb replacement.

Mounting Options

The verified mounting method is suspended downrod installation. The included rod set provides up to 46 inches of total rod length using three 12-inch rods, one 6-inch rod, and one 4-inch rod.

The chandelier is adaptable to sloped ceilings up to 45 degrees. The ceiling junction box and supporting structure must be suitable for the fixture and installed in accordance with local and national electrical codes.

Wiring & Safety

The fixture is designed for 120V electrical systems. Connect the supply hot, neutral, and grounding conductors according to the official installation instructions and all applicable electrical codes.

Do not exceed the maximum lamp rating of 60 watts per socket. Use four compatible E12 Type G bulbs. Bulbs are sold separately. Ensure all glass shades, rods, fasteners, and mounting components are secure before restoring power.

Do not install the chandelier in damp or wet locations. This model is rated for dry indoor use only.

column3:
Alora Mood Sydney FM553211AGWH LED Flush Mount

The Alora Mood Sydney FM553211AGWH is a low-profile integrated LED flush mount finished in Aged Gold and White. Its square silhouette, frosted glass diffuser, and warm 3000K light make it a refined choice for bedrooms, hallways, living spaces, dining areas, and other dry interior locations.

Key Strengths

  • Integrated LED Lighting: Uses a built-in 23W AC LED light source, eliminating the need for replaceable bulbs.
  • Warm 3000K Output: Produces comfortable warm-white illumination for residential interiors.
  • High Color Quality: Delivers 90 CRI for accurate rendering of finishes, furnishings, and skin tones.
  • Low-Profile Design: Extends only 2 inches from the mounting surface.
  • ELV Dimming: Supports dimming with a compatible electronic low-voltage dimmer sold separately.
  • Flexible Installation: Approved for ceiling or wall mounting in any orientation.

Product Overview

The Sydney FM553211AGWH from Alora Mood combines a slim square form with a decorative Aged Gold and White finish. Its frosted glass diffuser softens the integrated LED light source and creates a clean, even appearance without visible lamps.

The fixture measures 11-1/8 inches long, 11-1/8 inches wide, and 2 inches high. Its compact projection makes it suitable for rooms with low ceilings, narrow circulation areas, and spaces where a suspended fixture would not be practical.

The integrated 23W LED system produces 1,870 total lumens and 958 delivered lumens at a fixed 3000K color temperature. A 90 CRI rating helps preserve natural color appearance in everyday residential settings.

Ideal For

  • Bedrooms
  • Living rooms
  • Dining areas
  • Hallways and corridors
  • Entryways and foyers
  • Home offices
  • Dry interior wall applications

Key Performance Benefits

The integrated LED design provides a complete light source within the fixture, so separate bulbs are not required. The low 23W power draw delivers useful ambient illumination while maintaining a compact fixture profile.

The frosted glass diffuser reduces direct glare and creates a more uniform luminous surface. The 3000K color temperature provides a warm-white appearance suitable for comfortable residential lighting.

ELV dimming allows light output to be adjusted with a compatible electronic low-voltage dimmer. The product information identifies a dimming range from full output down to approximately 10 percent when used with suitable controls and proper wiring.

The fixture may be installed on either a ceiling or a wall and supports all-orientation mounting. This flexibility allows the same design to be used as a flush ceiling light or as a decorative surface-mounted wall fixture in a dry location.

The Sydney FM553211AGWH is designed for direct surface mounting to a properly installed electrical junction box. It may be mounted on a ceiling or wall in any orientation, provided the mounting surface and electrical box can safely support the fixture.

Before installation, disconnect power at the breaker or fuse panel. Secure the mounting hardware to the electrical box, connect the supply conductors to the fixture conductors according to the manufacturer’s instructions, and fasten the fixture body so it sits evenly against the mounting surface.

Because this product contains an integrated LED light source and is ELV dimmable, installation should be completed by a qualified, licensed electrician familiar with electronic low-voltage dimming systems.

Mounting Options

The verified installation options include ceiling mounting and wall mounting in any orientation. The fixture’s 2-inch profile makes it suitable for low ceilings and compact wall applications where a minimal projection is preferred.

This model is intended for dry indoor locations only. Do not install it where it will be directly exposed to moisture, rain, or wet conditions.

Wiring & Safety

The fixture operates on 120V input and contains an integrated 23W AC LED light source. Follow the official installation instructions and all applicable local and national electrical codes when connecting hot, neutral, and grounding conductors.

Disconnect electrical power before installation, servicing, or cleaning. Do not modify the fixture, LED components, or internal wiring. Confirm that all connections are secure and that the fixture is firmly attached before restoring power.

When dimming is required, use only a compatible ELV dimmer rated for the fixture’s LED load. An incompatible control may cause flickering, limited dimming range, noise, or improper operation.

column2: Abra Lighting Electron 20" Mitered Glass Outdoor Wall Sconce - 20W, 3000K
column3:
Abra Lighting Electron 20" Mitered Glass Outdoor Wall Sconce – 50149ODW

The Abra Lighting Electron 50149ODW is a 20-inch outdoor LED wall sconce designed for contemporary exterior walls, entrances, patios, and building façades. Its integrated LED system, wet-location rating, and mitered glass diffuser provide dependable illumination with a clean architectural appearance.

Key Strengths

  • Integrated LED: Uses a 20-watt solid-state LED module that delivers 1,700 lumens.
  • Warm White Light: Produces 3000K illumination with a 90+ CRI.
  • Wet-Location Rated: Designed for installation on exposed exterior walls.
  • Mitered Glass Diffuser: Softens the light while supporting the fixture’s modern profile.
  • Dimmable Operation: Compatible with verified C•L and ELV dimming controls.
  • ADA-Compliant Projection: Extends approximately 3.5 inches from the wall.

Product Overview & Key Applications

The Abra Electron 50149ODW combines a slim metal frame with a white mitered glass diffuser to create a streamlined outdoor wall fixture. Measuring 20 inches high and 4.75 inches wide, it provides substantial vertical presence while maintaining a shallow 3.5-inch extension from the mounting surface. The fixture is available in Matte Black and Silica finishes, allowing it to coordinate with a range of modern residential and commercial exteriors.

Its integrated 20-watt LED light source produces 1,700 lumens at a warm 3000K color temperature.
